rules.description: Applicant must live in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: You must live in the UK to claim Child Benefit

rules.description: Child must now primarily live with the applicant
rules.reason_if_failed: Child Benefit can only be claimed by the person the child primarily lives with

rules.description: Child must be under 16, or under 20 if in approved education or training
rules.reason_if_failed: Child Benefit is only available for children under 16, or under 20 if in approved education or training

rules.description: There must be an existing Child Benefit claim for this child
rules.reason_if_failed: No existing Child Benefit claim found for this child. You may need to make a new claim instead.

rules.description: The other parent must confirm they are stopping their claim
rules.reason_if_failed: Both parents cannot claim Child Benefit for the same child. The current claimant must stop their claim first.

rules.description: Applicant must be responsible for bringing up the child
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be responsible for bringing up the child to claim Child Benefit

edge_cases.description: Both parents claim the child lives with them or dispute living arrangements
edge_cases.action: HMRC will decide who gets Child Benefit. Route to manual assessment. Both parents may need to provide evidence of child's living arrangements.

edge_cases.description: Child spends equal time with both parents
edge_cases.action: Parents must agree who claims. If no agreement, HMRC decides. Only one parent can receive Child Benefit.

edge_cases.description: New claimant or their partner earns over £60,000
edge_cases.action: Inform applicant they may need to pay High Income Child Benefit Charge. They can opt out of payments but still get National Insurance credits.

edge_cases.description: Child is in local authority care
edge_cases.action: Check if local council is paying maintenance. If yes, Child Benefit cannot be claimed. Route to specialist advisor.

edge_cases.description: Child is 16-19 and education status needs verification
edge_cases.action: Verify child is in approved education or training. May require evidence from education provider.
